scope: Measured particle-PBF throughput/quality frontier and production-architecture residency feasibility. No custom grid work, no history/settings/default changes. All ten CUDA optimisations retained.
reuse: Use previous physical/architecture results for triage and known consistency failures; do not rerun settled formulation studies. Fresh raw observations are necessary for multiscene independent-control frontier and current full-solver timings.

fixed_physics.mass: Keep exact Rust-resolved baseline mass/rest bits.
fixed_physics.constraint: Production signed Poly6/Spiky; no clamping, boundary support or kernel change in first frontier.
fixed_physics.velocity_effects: XSPH and confinement disabled, as retained performance baseline.
fixed_physics.geometry: Immutable per scene; no resolution/spacing refinement in parameter sweep.
fixed_physics.configuration: Schema2, refine factor1. Explicit dt and correction independently pinned; resolved JSON bits checked before use.

practical.purpose: Explicit application error budget for a visually useful bulk liquid; not research-grade incompressible/Newtonian validation. Historical stricter failures stay failed.
practical.notes: Density5% retains original health screen.10% bulk/volume/energy and20% shear loss are prospective application tolerances allowing modest compressibility/dissipation, not fitted material laws. No quietness-at5s requirement: preserve prior result but assess energy/motion against independent references. CFL warnings reported, not silently suppressed; finite stability alone is insufficient.

research.constant_pressure_and_shear_consistency: Prior mathematical failures remain; not rerun or waived.
research.energy: Match independent inviscid/viscous reference, not arbitrary damping.
research.convergence: Spatial/timestep/iteration convergence and boundary/free-surface consistency required. No PBF parameter selection can erase established formulation limitations.

frontier_design.screen: Production baseline and independent one-factor controls about a declared anchor, with remaining quantities bit-pinned. Reference anchor chosen from prior triage, not a qualified winner: dt1/240,I8,scale0.5,epsilon*h^2=2.
frontier_design.scenes: Resolved falling block8000; hydrostatic full-width3200; resolved collision3456; free-surface spreading3200; unforced volume-preserving shear8000. Large110592 falling block for admitted/near-frontier policies.
frontier_design.extension: Selected fastest/nondominated policies and production baseline through5s, plus dt/iteration controls; all failures retained.
frontier_design.timing: Full production CLI completed-step total per actual simulated second, output/setup/audits excluded. Native quality replay separately matched byte-for-byte to production endpoints; never called production timing. Final comparisons one warmup and3 alternating repeats; no concurrent GPU workload.
frontier_design.bounds: No exhaustive Cartesian tuning. At most18 independent-control screen policies, then at most6 focused combinations justified by observed frontier and existing evidence.
frontier_design.residency: Assess snapshot()/particles() ownership and failure/cancellation contracts. Test only safe explicit GPU-owned experimental execution in isolated production source export, preserving old API. Keep per-stage checks, dynamic rows and cell width; no fixed512 cap shortcut.
frontier_design.alternative_trigger: If no efficient PBF policy passes practical criteria, run/assess pinned established DFSPH with explicit mass/kernel/boundary/timer differences before any further custom grid development.

retention: Durable local and primary-home evidence; exact inputs, source/build identities, raw sampled states, failure records, timings and checksummed readback. No temporary-only archive.
